test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'causes' **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a verb that means 'creating diseases'.
 
• The sentence is in simple present tense with a singular subject 'It'.
 
• Thus the blanks needs a simple present tense singular verb which means 'giving rise to diseases'
 
• Therefore 'causes' is the appropriate option for filling the given blank.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Let us look at other options:

 
• 'have caused' is present perfect tense 
 
• 'have been causing' is present continuous tense 
 
• 'cause' is a plural verb.
 
• Hence all the other options are inappropriate here.
